name: Jeff Anderson
summary: Began suing the Catholic Church over clergy abuse in the 1980s and has since represented survivors in diocese cases and bankruptcies across the country.

outcomes.institution: Archdiocese of St. Paul and Minneapolis
outcomes.result: $210 million bankruptcy settlement for about 450 survivors
$34 million settlement with 93 claimants

name: Anthony T. DiPietro
summary: Represented most of the former patients who sued Columbia University and NewYork-Presbyterian over gynecologist Robert Hadden. Columbia's Hadden payouts now total more than $1 billion.

outcomes.result: $165 million settlement with 147 former Hadden patients
$750 million settlement with 576 former Hadden patients
outcomes.role: Handled most of the Columbia claims

name: Brad Edwards
summary: Has represented Jeffrey Epstein's accusers since 2008, including in suits against the banks that served Epstein. Epstein sued him in 2009 and in 2018 publicly apologized and withdrew his claims.

outcomes.result: $75 million class settlement with Epstein survivors
$290 million class settlement with Epstein survivors
$72.5 million settlement with Epstein accusers

name: Mitchell Garabedian
summary: Represented clergy abuse survivors in Boston before and after the 2002 Boston Globe Spotlight investigation, and has continued to bring and settle claims against the archdiocese and religious orders.

outcomes.result: $10 million settlement with 86 people who said they were abused by priest John Geoghan
$85 million global settlement covering 552 claimants
outcomes.role: One of several survivors' firms; represented about 120 claimants

name: John C. Manly
summary: Lead or co-lead counsel in several of the largest institutional abuse settlements in U.S. history, including the cases over Larry Nassar and USC gynecologist George Tyndall.

outcomes.result: $500 million settlement with 332 people abused by Larry Nassar
$852 million global settlement over George Tyndall
outcomes.role: One of several firms; represented 234 plaintiffs

outcomes.institution: USA Gymnastics and U.S. Olympic & Paralympic Committee
outcomes.result: $380 million settlement with Nassar survivors
outcomes.role: One of several firms; represented dozens of the women

outcomes.result: $138.7 million settlement of 139 claims over the FBI's handling of the Nassar allegations

name: Annika K. Martin
summary: Class action lawyer who co-led the federal class case for former USC student patients of gynecologist George Tyndall.

outcomes.result: $215 million federal class settlement for Tyndall's former patients, given final approval in February 2020
outcomes.role: One of the lead class counsel

name: Sigrid McCawley
base: Fort Lauderdale, Florida, and New York
summary: Managing partner at Boies Schiller Flexner who has represented Epstein survivors, including in the class actions against the banks that served him.

outcomes.result: $290 million class settlement with Epstein survivors
outcomes.role: Victims' attorney, with David Boies and co-counsel

outcomes.result: $75 million class settlement with Epstein survivors
outcomes.role: Her firm was class counsel with Edwards Pottinger

name: Rus Rilee
summary: His small firm led the wave of lawsuits, beginning in 2020, by people who say they were abused as children at New Hampshire's Youth Development Center, later working alongside Nixon Peabody.

outcomes.result: $38 million jury verdict for a former Youth Development Center resident in the first YDC abuse trial
outcomes.role: Trial counsel for the plaintiff, with Nixon Peabody

outcomes.result: A judge cut the $38 million award to $475,000 under the state's damages cap; the plaintiff appealed, and the New Hampshire Supreme Court heard arguments in November 2025

name: Ken Rothweiler
summary: Mass tort lawyer whose firm represented more than 16,000 people who said they were abused in Scouting.

outcomes.result: $850 million settlement with the BSA and local councils, later folded into the $2.46 billion reorganization plan confirmed in 2022
outcomes.role: One of three lead negotiators for survivors

name: Parker Stinar
firm: Stinar Lannen (formerly Stinar Gould Grieco & Hensley)
summary: Represented former University of Michigan athletes and students who said they were abused by team doctor Robert Anderson.

outcomes.result: $490 million settlement with 1,050 people who said Robert Anderson abused them
